muc.title: Got ideas, can't design
muc.text: You have an idea for a landing page or a slide deck, but you can't design. Claude Design does that part for you.

muc.title: Chat on the left, canvas on the right
muc.text: The screen splits in two: you chat on the left, and the right side is a canvas. You describe it in words, and Claude draws the first version right away.

muc.title: What can it make?
muc.text: It can make presentation slides, one-page landing pages, and even prototypes, meaning sample apps you can click through like the real thing.

muc.title: Edit with words or by hand
muc.text: Not happy yet? Keep talking: bigger text, a different photo. Or adjust it directly on the canvas. You can also upload photos, Word, PowerPoint or Excel files as material.

muc.title: Save your brand once
muc.text: The best part is the design system: save your colors, fonts and logo once, and everything you make afterwards matches your brand automatically.

muc.title: Where, and which plan?
muc.text: Claude Design is in beta, for Pro plans and up, and opens on the web or the desktop app.

muc.title: A landing page for your shop
muc.text: Describe a landing page for your shop or club: the name, three highlights, opening hours, the main color. Edit it twice with words, then send the link to friends for feedback.

muc.title: Projects and Memory
muc.text: You've made lots of things for one task. Where do you keep them tidy? Part 4: Projects and Memory.
